words.gloss: to those who have a heart

literal: To those who have a heart joined with compassion, there is no entering into the painful world joined with darkness.
translation: For those whose hearts are filled with compassion, there is no entry into the sorrowful world of darkness.
modern: அருள் நிறைந்த நெஞ்சத்தை உடையவர்களுக்கு, இருள் சூழ்ந்த துன்ப உலகத்தில் நுழைதல் என்பது இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the protective nature of compassion (அருள்). The author explains that those who possess a heart filled with grace and kindness will never have to experience the dark, painful world of misery. Here, 'darkness' (இருள்) represents ignorance and confusion, while the 'painful world' (இன்னா உலகம்) refers to a state of suffering. By cultivating compassion, a person is naturally shielded from entering these dark states of existence.
